summary_en: 650,000 shares (3.08% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired at ¥2.5B upper limit via open-market purchase Aug 4–Nov 30, 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled. Stated rationale: enhanced shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Terms of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Daitron Co., Ltd. announced a share buyback authorized by board resolution on August 3, 2026. The company will acquire up to 650,000 ordinary shares (3.08% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at an aggregate cost not to exceed ¥2.5 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 4 to November 30, 2026. All shares acquired under this program will subsequently be cancelled; the cancellation date will be announced following completion of the acquisition. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 183,552 treasury shares against 21,083,146 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
